0335__L11_Mad_5__3320A24D.mp3.asr_text: Here it comes! The artillery boys keep better time than Big Ben!
0335__L11_Mad_5__3320A24D.mp3.translation: 来了！炮兵比大本钟还准时！

0336__L11_Red_1__B7C322CA.mp3.asr_text: So we sneak in behind them, eh Sarge?
0336__L11_Red_1__B7C322CA.mp3.translation: 所以咱们从他们背后摸进去，对吧，中士？

0338__L11_Tay_37__6162B12C.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, there's a Jedi sniper rifle here. Reckon you can get a bead on my gun crew.
0338__L11_Tay_37__6162B12C.mp3.translation: 夏普，这儿有把德国狙击步枪。看看能不能瞄到那几个炮手。
0338__L11_Tay_37__6162B12C.mp3.note: Jedi疑似Jerry；my gun crew疑似that gun crew。按敌方狙击枪与炮组语境拟译，待听音。

0340__L11_Tay_35__6146822A.mp3.asr_text: Another 88 to the north. They will dug in. It'll take a while to flank them.
0340__L11_Tay_35__6146822A.mp3.translation: 北边还有一门八八炮。守得挺严，绕过去要花点工夫。
0340__L11_Tay_35__6146822A.mp3.note: They will dug in疑似They're well dug in，按阵地防守严密理解。

0343__L11_Mad_11__2A29ACC4.mp3.asr_text: Flank the half-track and take out that damn MG!
0343__L11_Mad_11__2A29ACC4.mp3.translation: 绕到半履带车侧面，端掉那挺该死的机枪！

0344__L11_Mad_57__31519C46.mp3.asr_text: Fall back! We hold him here!
0344__L11_Mad_57__31519C46.mp3.translation: 后撤！就在这儿挡住他们！

0345__L11_Mad_22__2BEC9CE4.mp3.asr_text: Come on, lads! This is where we earn our breakfast!
0345__L11_Mad_22__2BEC9CE4.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，上！干完这活儿才有早饭吃！

0346__L11_Red_9__B833DED2.mp3.note: OFF TRACK疑似half-track，按车辆警告修正。

0347__L11_Mad_10__2A1B9543.mp3.asr_text: Off the road, into the house!

0349__L11_Tay_68__668F528A.mp3.asr_text: I'm beginning to think they don't like us.
0349__L11_Tay_68__668F528A.mp3.translation: 我开始觉得他们不太欢迎咱们。

0350__L11_Mad_60__32A3D05E.mp3.asr_text: Last push lads! Don't let me down now!
0350__L11_Mad_60__32A3D05E.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，最后再冲一把！别让我失望！

0351__L11_Mad_6__332EB9CE.mp3.asr_text: Righto, lads. Taylor, Sharp, take out that checkpoint.
0351__L11_Mad_6__332EB9CE.mp3.translation: 好了，弟兄们。泰勒、夏普，拿下那个检查站。

0352__L11_Mad_2__32F65BCA.mp3.asr_text: That's a ticket, lad. We take out their gun positions so our boys can cross without Jerry shelling the blazes out of them.
0352__L11_Mad_2__32F65BCA.mp3.translation: 对了，伙计。端掉他们的炮兵阵地，咱们的人才能渡河，不用挨德国人的炮轰。

0353__L11_Red_29__42D0330A.mp3.asr_text: My God! What the hell is that?!

0355__L11_Mad_54__312755C3.mp3.asr_text: Sharp! Get down there and hold him back!

0356__L11_Red_34__443E9624.mp3.asr_text: There's a Jerry Ammo, Dam Sarge. Top of the big house.
0356__L11_Red_34__443E9624.mp3.translation: 中士，那栋大房子上面有德军弹药库。
0356__L11_Red_34__443E9624.mp3.note: Ammo, Dam疑似ammo dump，按弹药库理解；具体楼层待画面校对。

0360__L11_Red_28__42C21B89.mp3.asr_text: More Jerries coming up from the river!
0360__L11_Red_28__42C21B89.mp3.translation: 又有德军从河边上来了！

0361__L11_Mad_19__2A9A68CC.mp3.translation: 把那支反坦克火箭筒架好！

0363__L11_Tay_3__97C658A7.mp3.asr_text: Couple of jerrys on a checkpoint round the corner. Otherwise it's all quiet, Sarge.
0363__L11_Tay_3__97C658A7.mp3.translation: 转角的检查站有几个德军，其它地方都很安静，中士。

0364__L11_Mad_30__2D854681.mp3.asr_text: Noble Werfer, bloody big Jerry Rocky, son. You all know the drill. Kill the crews and put them out of action.
0364__L11_Mad_30__2D854681.mp3.translation: 喷烟者，德国人的大火箭炮。老办法，清掉炮手，让它们开不了火。
0364__L11_Mad_30__2D854681.mp3.note: Noble Werfer / Jerry Rocky疑似Nebelwerfer / Jerry rockets，按德军喷烟者火箭炮修正，不补未识别出的型号。

0366__L11_Red_50__476FE95E.mp3.asr_text: Trucks to the north, Sarge! They're bringing in more troops!
0366__L11_Red_50__476FE95E.mp3.translation: 中士，北边有卡车！他们又在增兵！

0368__L11_Mad_31__2D935E02.mp3.asr_text: Over the gap in that wall! On the double-eds!
0368__L11_Mad_31__2D935E02.mp3.translation: 从墙上的缺口过去！弟兄们，快！
0368__L11_Mad_31__2D935E02.mp3.note: double-eds疑似double, lads，按催促全队理解。

0369__L11_Mad_23__2BFAB465.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，端掉那门八八炮！

0373__L11_Red_40__45BB10BF.mp3.asr_text: There's a big jerry column heading our way.
0373__L11_Red_40__45BB10BF.mp3.translation: 一大队德军正往这边来。

0374__L11_Mad_63__32CE16E1.mp3.asr_text: Get to the ammo store and find us a Panzerschreck!
0374__L11_Mad_63__32CE16E1.mp3.translation: 去弹药库找一支反坦克火箭筒！

0375__L11_Mad_4__33128ACC.mp3.asr_text: It won't be for long. We're running late and the artillery barrage is gonna start any time now.
0375__L11_Mad_4__33128ACC.mp3.translation: 安静不了多久了。我们晚了，炮火随时会落下来。

0376__L11_Mad_0__32DA2CC8.mp3.asr_text: Jerry's waiting for the Rhine crossing, but he's not looking this way. All their guns will be pointing at the river.
0376__L11_Mad_0__32DA2CC8.mp3.translation: 德军在等我们渡过莱茵河，可没盯着这边。他们的炮口全朝着河面。

0378__L11_Tay_41__62C2FCC5.mp3.asr_text: Go downstairs and get on the MG shop!
0378__L11_Tay_41__62C2FCC5.mp3.note: MG shop疑似MG, Sharpe，按机枪与人名断句。

0379__L11_Red_49__4639E448.mp3.asr_text: Sarge, I can see them working around our flank. Not sure what they're up to.
0379__L11_Red_49__4639E448.mp3.translation: 中士，他们在往我们侧翼绕，不知道想干什么。

0380__L11_Mad_36__2DD9D387.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, get up into that house and see if you can find anything useful. I need that gun position taken out.
0380__L11_Mad_36__2DD9D387.mp3.translation: 夏普，上那栋房子里找找，有什么能用的。要端掉那个炮兵阵地。

0383__L11_Tay_15__5DDCD0EC.mp3.asr_text: Get down! Keep away from the windows!

0385__L11_Mad_44__2F727D24.mp3.asr_text: Taylor, get upstairs! I want to know what's coming our way!
0385__L11_Mad_44__2F727D24.mp3.translation: 泰勒，上楼！看看什么东西往这边来了！

0386__L11_Mad_45__2F8094A5.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, go find Taylor and tell him to get his backside here now!
0386__L11_Mad_45__2F8094A5.mp3.translation: 夏普，去找泰勒，叫他立刻给我滚过来！

0387__L11_Cap_62__866FAE9E.mp3.asr_text: Good show, men! Us and the Yanks are across the Rhine and Jerry's on the run! First beers are on me as soon as we get to Berlin!
0387__L11_Cap_62__866FAE9E.mp3.translation: 干得好，弟兄们！我们和美国人都过了莱茵河，德军正往后跑！到了柏林，头一轮酒我请！

0388__L11_Mad_8__334AE8D0.mp3.asr_text: Easy now, lads. Keep an eye out for Jerry.

0389__L11_Mad_25__2C16E367.mp3.asr_text: Get a move on, lads. We're running out of time. Those LVTs will be hitting the water any minute.
0389__L11_Mad_25__2C16E367.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，快点，没时间了。两栖车随时都可能下水。
